title: Kissed Spicy Irish Grapes Sushi
description: A light, spicy sushi featuring fresh black and green grapes, vinegared rice, and crisp pumpkin seeds for a burst of Irish flair.
instructions: Rinse 200g sushi rice until clear, then cook with 240ml water until tender and fluffy, about 20 minutes, then let cool.
Whisk 1 tbsp rice vinegar, 1 tsp sugar, and a pinch of salt until sugar dissolves.
Dice 50g black grapes and 50g green grapes, then toss with the vinegar mixture, 1 tsp sriracha, 1 tsp sesame oil, lemon zest, mint, and black pepper, letting flavors mingle for 5 minutes.
Fill a shallow dish with the cooled rice, then form small, even rice balls about the size of a grape cluster, using a damp cloth to keep hands from sticking.
Place a grape cluster in the center of each rice ball, then gently compress the rice around the grapes to form a tight, nigiri‑style shape.
Sprinkle toasted pumpkin seeds and toasted sesame seeds over the top of each sushi piece, then drizzle a thin line of sriracha over the seeds for extra heat.
Arrange the kissed spicy Irish grape sushi on a chilled plate, garnish with thin seaweed strips if desired, and serve immediately.
Enjoy the fresh, spicy, and crisp bite of Irish grapes wrapped in vinegared sushi rice.
